crumb: how does a running state-mode session
autosave back into the vault?

New engineers · Timer and signal saves from a running supervisor and the
Chrome it owns into encrypted per-account vault files.

Supervisor's
Playwright context,
not a peer

setInterval every
--autosave secs
(default 30; 0
disables).
SIGINT/SIGTERM do a
final save; SIGUSR2
saves (non-Windows).
Concurrent saves
coalesce; unchanged
snapshots skipped.

mergeState(latest,
before, after) plus
browser hints, written
with 'sync' provenance
via 0600 temp file +
rename. No lock
against other writers.

Save errors are only
logged. If Chrome's
context closes on its
own, the supervisor
exits with no final
save. Vault key:
CRUMB_KEY, OS
keychain/secret-servic
e, or 0600 key file.

Outside this view: Launch, manual CLI close/sync commands and plaintext run handle files;
login, capture, check, transfer and profile-mode sessions.
